timestamp_semantics: Monotonic logical append time after the Campaign277 final validated state; not a market-data or host-wall-clock measurement.
objective: Freeze a finite priority-ordered catalog of economically independent issuer external-state mechanisms before any Campaign278 targeted prior-definition or source-frontier search.

catalog_selection_rule.selection_method: After this file is immutable, inspect complete local terminal-definition and source-frontier evidence in catalog priority order. Select the first route that is economically independent, has a lawful and auditable 2019-2023 point-in-time issuer identity, availability, revision and complete-market denominator contract, and is not a same-mechanism source, entity-role, jurisdiction, formula, field, window or cohort rescue. Close every sibling and parameter variant. If no route survives, terminalize Campaign278 before formula, direction, provider, fields, source rows, factor values, comparison values, prices or returns.

concept_catalog.economic_state: Issuer resilience to earthquakes, floods, fires and other public disasters reflected in business interruption, emergency support, recovery, reopening and closure lifecycle records.
Issuer food-service and processing quality reflected in public sanitation grades, inspections, violations, temporary closures, remediation and reopening lifecycle records.
Issuer external-market access reflected in public import or export quota, tariff-rate quota, license allocation, utilization, transfer, suspension and cancellation lifecycle records.
Issuer decarbonization obligations and environmental-asset position reflected in public allowance or credit issuance, allocation, transfer, surrender, retirement and cancellation lifecycle records.

Issuer research capability and knowledge transfer reflected in public university or institute collaboration, project participation, publication, correction, withdrawal and completion lifecycle records.

Issuer regulated network capacity and market access reflected in public spectrum, numbering, route, airport-slot or similar scarce-capacity allocation, transfer, renewal, suspension and withdrawal lifecycle records.

Issuer discretionary social commitment and crisis response reflected in public charitable donation, in-kind support, relief participation, pledge fulfillment, withdrawal and correction lifecycle records.
